instruction: A cinematic still, medium shot of a dimly lit indoor room with teal curtains. On the left, the woman with long twist braids (R2) sits on the lap of the shirtless man (R1) on the right, leaning her face close to his. She cradles his head with her left hand. Both have their eyes closed, sharing a quiet, intimate smile. Warm orange light highlights their skin against the cool teal background.
